definition: situated at the front; earlier in time
memoryTip: Ante = before — the front side, or what came earlier.
correctPassage: Pain was reported in the anterior portion of the shoulder.
wrongPassages: The posterior wall is also called the anterior face of the building.
The sequel was anterior to the original film that started the franchise.
After the final chapter, nothing anterior remained — only what came next.

definition: gather or accumulate in large amount
memoryTip: A-mass: pile up a mass of something over time.
correctPassage: Over decades the library amassed one of the finest map collections in the region.
wrongPassages: He amassed the debt by paying every bill the day it arrived.
The museum amassed the exhibit by giving away its rarest pieces.
She amassed the leftovers by throwing them out before anyone could take seconds.

definition: agree; occur at the same time
memoryTip: Con-cur: run together — same opinion, or same moment.
correctPassage: Most reviewers concur that the second edition is clearer than the first.
wrongPassages: The two panels concurred by publishing opposite findings on the same day.
She concurred the locked door with a polite note left underneath.
Doctors called the recovery concur when the patient left the same afternoon.

memoryTip: Inter + cede: step between parties and plead for someone.
correctPassage: A neutral mediator agreed to intercede between the two companies.
wrongPassages: The referee will intercede the match by walking off and refusing all appeals.
She interceded her own promotion without mentioning anyone else.
Teachers called the essay intercede after it defined every term in advance.

definition: a small improvement; elegance or polish
memoryTip: Make finer — polish the details until it feels elegant.
correctPassage: Each refinement of the model improved its predictive accuracy.
wrongPassages: The first crude sketch was already a refinement of the finished product.
They stored the refinement on a shelf next to spare batteries and tape.
His refinement of the plan removed every improvement and restored the bugs.
